name: yardigo
description: Nederlandse garage sale & rommelmarkt discovery app.

scripts._copy-web: cp index.html www/index.html && cp index.html www/yardigo-v21.html && cp home.html www/home.html && cp sw.js www/sw.js && cp manifest.json www/manifest.json && cp cedrik-ob-s1.png cedrik-ob-s2.png cedrik-ob-s3.png cedrik-ob-s4.png bouwen2.png og-image.png www/
